# What does this PR do?

Migrate DDP/FSDP wrapper settings and consumers to `cfg.ddp` as part of training-loop configuration consolidation (C09).

- Use the resolved wrapper config for construction, bucket/layout settings, communication hooks and checkpoint backend selection.
- Retain the Torch FSDP2-specific schema and all existing CLI flags. Keep `use_megatron_fsdp` only in `cfg.ddp`.
- Centralize wrapper validation and cross-config derivation. Optimizer-owned overlap settings remain authoritative in `cfg.optimizer`; runtime copies keep bucket/timer mutations out of serialized configuration.
- Preserve existing optimizer extension hooks and add behavioral coverage in existing test modules.

This remains a draft. It does not change GPU kernels or introduce a new checkpoint format. Rebased on main after optimizer migration #8213; the optimizer-owned flags are resolved before deriving the DDP layout. Both FSDP selectors now live in `cfg.ddp`, not `cfg.dist`.

Validation remains read-only, including config edits after construction. Cross-config derivations live in the container's `_finalize()`. MCore's existing construction defaults remain compatible with standalone callers and Bridge's deferred initialization. Inference loads use checkpoint-format policy when no training wrapper config exists.

## Issue tracking

Related to #3554.

## Contribution process

### Pre-checks

- [x] I have added relevant unit tests
- [ ] I have added relevant functional tests
- [ ] If this PR adds or changes a GPU kernel, I have added or updated its bit-exact determinism test (not applicable: configuration ownership only)
- [x] I have added proper typing to my code
- [x] I have added relevant documentation
- [ ] I have run the autoformatter on my PR

Validation for rebased head `0951548e6` (main `037b883c9`):
- Eight-GPU broad integration run: **836 passed / 159 skipped per rank**; its two failures were newly merged tests still changing the legacy FSDP argument. Those assertions were migrated to the config owner and verified in the final focused run.
- Final two-GPU run: **331 passed per rank**, including the corrected assertions, optimizer/DDP finalization, non-mutating validation, deferred defaults, inference backend selection, and training/inference/converter checkpoint round trips.
- Matched main/head FSDP checks: **5 passed / 1 identical baseline failure per rank on both revisions**. The existing `test_fsdp2_swiglu_sharded_tensor_factory` expects one shard but gets two; left unchanged. MFSDP v1 process groups and MFSDP v2 meta initialization/train-step checks pass.
- Changed Core/test files pass Black, Ruff and pinned Pylint 3.2.6; edited imports were checked with isort. Syntax and diff checks pass. The autoformatter wrapper remains unavailable locally because it requires Git >= 2.31.
- The full fork-only seam matrix was not rerun for this update.

No copyright-year changes or unrelated formatting changes were included.

### Code review

Independent complete-diff review completed before publication. Keep draft while upstream CI and remaining integration review proceed.
